summary.intent: Improve the `entire insights` and `entire improve` CLI commands to be more useful: fix broken scoring, add on-demand summary backfill, surface tool usage data, and fix pattern detection in `improve`.
summary.outcome: Fixed all-zero scores by rewriting token efficiency and focus scoring formulas; added automatic summary backfill so insights/improve work without pre-existing summaries; added tool call tracking (schema, extraction, display); fixed improve's pattern detection to use keyword-theme grouping instead of exact-match SQL; committed three separate commits across the session.

repo: Summaries are generated by `summarize` package during post-commit condensation and stored in checkpoint metadata on `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch; insights/improve read from SQLite cache populated from that metadata.

The `nolint:ireturn` comments in `agent/capabilities.go` were removed in an earlier branch commit (`1716fa72`) and keep getting stripped by `gofmt` when long lines are reformatted — they need to be re-added carefully without making lines too long.
The `improve` dry-run path was calling `QueryRecurringFriction` (exact SQL match) instead of `AnalyzePatterns` (keyword-theme grouping), so it never surfaced patterns even with many friction entries.
The `nullableFloat` pattern for score columns caused 0.0 scores to be stored as NULL, making scored sessions indistinguishable from unsummarized ones.
Token efficiency score was using tokens-per-file with an 8k baseline, but real sessions use 300k–6M tokens per file, making the score always 0. Fix: use tokens-per-turn with a log-scale baseline.
Tool names and skill details are available in `summarize.Entry.ToolName` and `summarize.Entry.ToolDetail` from the condensed transcript.
The `tool_calls` table needed a new schema version bump in `db.go` to be auto-created on first run.

code.finding: Added `maxFrictionExamples = 10` cap to prevent unbounded accumulation that could blow up LLM prompt context.
Added `UpdateSessionSummary` method to update existing session rows with summary data and set `has_summary=1` without re-inserting the full row.
Token efficiency now uses log-scale tokens-per-turn formula; focus uses gaussian curve centered at 5 files; first-pass baseline is 90 with turn-count and open-item penalties.
`attachTranscriptExcerpts` was rebuilt to use `AffectedSessions` from `FrictionPattern` directly instead of querying DB by exact friction text.
`Execute` now returns `(string, *UsageInfo, error)` where `UsageInfo` contains `InputTokens`, `OutputTokens`, and `TotalCostUSD` parsed from Claude CLI JSON response.
`backfillSummaries` queries sessions with `has_summary=false`, generates summaries via Claude, and updates cache — called at start of both `runInsights` and `runImprove`.

workflow: When `gofmt` is run as part of lint, it can strip long trailing comments including `nolint` directives — run lint without fmt first to check nolint issues separately.
After a `replace_all` Edit, verify that function definitions weren't also renamed unintentionally.
Capabilities.go nolint comments need to be on the same line as the return statement, not as trailing comments on long function signatures, to survive gofmt.

friction: `gofmt` repeatedly stripped `nolint:ireturn` comments from `agent/capabilities.go` across multiple sessions because the lines were too long — required re-adding 8 times across multiple commits.
`replace_all` in Edit renamed the function definition itself in addition to call sites in `manual_commit_condensation.go`, requiring a follow-up fix.
The `capabilities.go` nolint fix was included in the simplify session's edits but not staged/committed, causing lint failures in the next commit.
`entire improve --dry-run` returned 0 patterns despite 197 friction items in the DB because it used exact-match SQL instead of keyword-theme grouping.
All insights scores showed 0.0 for recent sessions because `metadataToSessionRow` gated all score computation behind `if meta.Summary != nil`, even for dimensions that don't need summaries.
The backfill command output was hard to verify during development because the background task notification came after the session had moved on.
open_items: `SessionRow.CacheTokens` field is declared but never populated — noted but deferred.
`statusStyles` wrapper in `status_style.go` adds indirection over `termstyle.Styles` — could be removed but requires broader refactoring.
`TotalTokens` lives in the `termstyle` presentation package but is a data computation — ideally should move to `agent` or a utility package.
N+1 query pattern in `insightsdb/queries.go` `populateDenormalized` — 3 extra queries per session row — deferred.
Stringly-typed status/priority/direction values across packages would benefit from typed constants — deferred.
The `improve` 'other' theme bucket catches friction that doesn't match any keyword — theme keywords should be expanded as real usage data accumulates.
Cost display for backfill summarization is not tracked — the `summarize/claude.go` caller discards `UsageInfo` since it runs in background context.

Tool call extraction reads from `summarize.Entry` structs rebuilt from the condensed transcript, but skills used via the Skill tool may need `ToolDetail` parsing to distinguish skill names from raw tool names.
